typedef long long LL;

const int N = 10;
const int M = 25;
const int S = 1048580;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

int num_people, prob[N][N], mat[N][N], pow2[M], a[N], b[N], f[S], g[S], total, id[70], points[M][N], state[M];
bool used[N];

int mod_pow(int x, int y) {
    int ans = 1;
    while (y) {
        if (y & 1) ans = (LL)ans * x % MOD;
        x = (LL)x * x % MOD;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

void init() {
    pow2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 20; ++i) pow2[i] = pow2[i-1] * 2;
    scanf("%d", &num_people);
    int inv = mod_pow(100, MOD-2);
    for (int i = 1; i <= num_people; ++i)
        for (int j = 1; j <= num_people; ++j) {
            scanf("%d", &prob[i][j]);
            prob[i][j] = (LL)prob[i][j] * inv % MOD;
        }
    while (num_people < 6) {
        ++num_people;
        prob[num_people][num_people] = 1;
    }
}

bool can_match(int x) {
    if (x > 3) return true;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i)
        if (!used[i] && mat[a[x]][b[i]]) {
            used[i] = true;
            bool flag = can_match(x + 1);
            used[i] = false;
            if (flag) return true;
        }
    return false;
}

void dfs2(int x, int y, int prod) {
    if (x > 3) {
        int s = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= total; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 3; ++j) b[j] = points[i][j];
            if (can_match(1)) s += pow2[i-1];
        }
        f[s] = (f[s] + prod) % MOD;
        return;
    }
    mat[a[x]][y] = 0;
    if (y == num_people) dfs2(x + 1, 1, (LL)prod * (1 - prob[a[x]][y] + MOD) % MOD);
    else dfs2(x, y + 1, (LL)prod * (1 - prob[a[x]][y] + MOD) % MOD);
    mat[a[x]][y] = 1;
    if (y == num_people) dfs2(x + 1, 1, (LL)prod * prob[a[x]][y] % MOD);
    else dfs2(x, y + 1, (LL)prod * prob[a[x]][y] % MOD);
}

void dfs1(int x, int y, int mask) {
    if (y == 3) {
        id[mask] = ++total;
        state[total] = mask;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) points[total][i] = a[i];
        return;
    }
    if (x > num_people) return;
    dfs1(x + 1, y, mask);
    a[y + 1] = x;
    dfs1(x + 1, y + 1, mask + pow2[x - 1]);
}

void transform_g() {
    for (int i = 0; i < total; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < pow2[total]; ++j)
            if (j & pow2[i]) g[j] = (g[j] + g[j ^ pow2[i]]) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    init();
    dfs1(1, 0, 0);
    a[1] = 1; a[2] = 2; a[3] = 3;
    dfs2(1, 1, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < pow2[total]; ++i) {
        int t = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= total; ++j) {
            int rev = id[pow2[num_people] - 1 - state[j]];
            if (i & pow2[j - 1]) t += pow2[rev - 1];
        }
        g[t] = f[i];
        f[i] = 0;
    }
    a[1] = 4; a[2] = 5; a[3] = 6;
    dfs2(1, 1, 1);
    transform_g();
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < pow2[total]; ++i)

    return 0;
}
